title: Chinese eating eggs fifty years old, blue and green again.
html_source: This is a reference to the so called Century Eggs, a delicacy in China. Despite their name and Blooms mention of “50 years”, the duck, chicken or quail eggs are standardly only preserved for several weeks to several months in a particular mixture of clay, ash, salt, quicklime, and rice hulls.
